purpose: Prove that the operator console distinguishes harness-managed control from direct MCP control without inventing an independent verifier.

managed_mode.title: Harness-managed control
managed_mode.visible_contract: The harness reasoner plans, the controller acts, and an independent verifier evaluates each machine transition.

direct_mode.title: Direct MCP control
direct_mode.visible_contract: The external client chooses tool calls. The daemon enforces policy and freshness. No independent model verifier is running.

claim_limits: The direct run was a synthetic local audit record and did not exercise HID.
This audit proves visible assurance labelling and responsive layout, not remote task accuracy.
Independent model verification is a managed-harness property and is explicitly not claimed for direct MCP control.
